app.name: Zimam
app.about: Named after the Abbasid Dīwān al-Zimām, the office that kept watch over every other office
app.updateReady: A new version of Zimam is ready

setup.title: Take the reins
setup.intro: Zimam gathers the issues and pull requests of the repositories you choose into one list you can search and filter. It runs in your browser and talks to no one but GitHub.
setup.tokenHelp: Read access is enough. The token stays in this browser and is only ever sent to api.github.com.
setup.fineGrainedHelp: Pick the organization as the resource owner and give it all repositories
setup.classic: or a classic token, which works across all your organizations
setup.checkAgain: The token changed. Press Continue to check it.
setup.offline: Couldn't reach GitHub, check your connection
setup.noPrivate: This token can't read private repositories. Add the repo scope to see them.
setup.someHelp: New ones join only once picked

contrib.title: My contributions
contrib.help: Repositories you committed to, opened pull requests or issues in, or reviewed
contrib.none: GitHub lists no contributions this token can read
contrib.noneRead: No contributions this token can read in what Zimam read. There may be more beyond it.
contrib.reposCut: Some repositories may be missing: GitHub lists only your 100 most recent of some kinds of contribution, or you opened more than Zimam reads.
contrib.countsCut: You opened more than the latest 1,000 pull requests or issues Zimam reads, so the counts marked + may be higher.
contrib.prs: no pull requests | 1 pull request | {n} pull requests
contrib.prsAtLeast: no pull requests | at least 1 pull request | at least {n} pull requests
contrib.issuesAtLeast: no issues | at least 1 issue | at least {n} issues
contrib.pickedCount: None added | 1 repository added | {n} repositories added
contrib.hidden: none hidden | 1 hidden by the filters | {n} hidden by the filters
contrib.pickShown: Add all shown | Add the one shown | Add all {n} shown

filters.more: {n} more, type to narrow them down

syntax.title: Filter by typing
syntax.author: Opened by someone
syntax.label: Has any of these labels
syntax.is: Also open, closed, merged, issue, pr and conflicting
syntax.no: Unassigned, or no:label for those without a label
syntax.me: You, whoever the token belongs to
syntax.minus: A minus before any of these leaves its matches out
syntax.quotes: Quotes keep spaces in a value

results.historyLoading: Older closed items are still arriving ({percent}%)

checks.title: Checks
checks.behind: Couldn't load them again: they may be out of date
checks.none: No checks on the last commit
checks.more: No more | 1 more on GitHub | {n} more on GitHub

issue.title: Issue {ref}
issue.missing: GitHub can't find this issue. It may have been deleted or moved, or this workspace's token can't read it.
issue.more: No more comments | Show 1 more comment | Show {n} more comments

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.layout: Shortcuts go by where the keys are, so they work the same with an Arabic layout.

does.search: Search, or filter a pull request's files
does.views: Open a saved view, in the sidebar's order
does.rowsArrows: Next or previous row, from a row
does.parts: Files, conversation, commits, checks; again to fold
does.viewed: Mark the file viewed, or the file or folder focused in the files tree

sync.paused: GitHub asked for a pause, back at {time}
sync.rate: {remaining} of {limit} GitHub requests left this hour

error.auth: GitHub no longer accepts this workspace's token
error.server: GitHub is having trouble, trying again shortly

settings.title: Settings
settings.reloadHelp: Clears what this browser saved for the workspace and loads it from GitHub again
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Its views go with it.
settings.exportHelp: Workspaces and views as a file, without tokens
settings.imported: Settings imported. Add a token to each workspace to use it.
settings.importFailed: That file isn't a Zimam settings file
settings.installHelp: Opens like any other app, and shows what was saved even offline

installVia.ios: To install, open the Share menu and choose Add to Home Screen
installVia.mac: To install, choose File, then Add to Dock

generated.title: Also treat as generated
generated.help: One pattern per line, like .gitattributes. GitHub's own list and each repository's linguist-generated marks always count.
generated.bad: These lines aren't patterns and are skipped: {patterns}

repos.openedSoFar: Opened in the last 6 months: {n} so far, still loading
repos.move: Move {name}: drag it, or use the up and down arrows

pull.unticked: Changed since you last viewed it
pull.looseThreads: No threads off the current code | 1 thread on code that has since changed | {n} threads on code that has since changed
pull.empty: Only the name or mode changed.
pull.expandUp: Show {n} line above | Show {n} lines above
pull.expandDown: Show {n} line below | Show {n} lines below
pull.hiddenLines: No unchanged lines | 1 unchanged line | {n} unchanged lines
pull.rewritten: Too many changes to pair line by line in time, so the file shows as removed, then added.

scope.label: Commits shown
scope.capped: GitHub lists only the first 300 files these commits change.
scope.shift: Shift-click another commit to pick the run between them.

pull.generatedHidden: No generated files | 1 generated file hidden | {n} generated files hidden
pull.hideGenerated: Hide generated files | Hide the generated file | Hide {n} generated files
pull.noEnd: No newline at end of file
pull.capped: GitHub lists only the first 3,000 files of a pull request, and this one changes {n}.
pull.cappedMaybe: GitHub lists only the first 3,000 files of a pull request, and this one may change more.
pull.cappedEnd: GitHub lists no more of the files.
pull.cut: This conversation is too long to read here in full: its latest posts and review threads are on GitHub.

since.title: Since your last visit {when}
since.files: no files changed | 1 file changed | {n} files changed
since.comments: no comments | 1 new comment | {n} new comments
since.legend: What you saw before is faded; new lines have a blue bar.
since.firstVisit: Your first visit. Next time, what you've already seen will be faded.

events.pushed: pushed no commits | pushed 1 commit | pushed {n} commits
events.draft: {who} turned this back into a draft
events.unrequested: {who} no longer asks {whom} for a review
events.rebased: {who} changed the base branch from {from} to {to}

pull.checkingConflicts: GitHub is still checking for conflicts
pull.wants: {who} wants to merge {n} commits into {base} from {head}
pull.withoutGenerated: Without generated files | Without the generated file. With it: +{added} −{removed} | Without {n} generated files. With them: +{added} −{removed}
pull.wanted: {who} wanted to merge {n} commits into {base} from {head}
pull.awaitingCount: Nobody awaited | Awaiting 1 reviewer | Awaiting {n} reviewers
pull.readFailed: GitHub couldn't give this file's text.
